kp1:1.1: Reverence to him, the Fortunate One, the Worthy One, the Perfect Sambuddha
kp1:2.1: I go to the Buddha for refuge,
kp1:2.2: I go to the Dhamma for refuge,
kp1:2.3: I go to the Sangha for refuge.
kp1:3.1: For a second time I go to the Buddha for refuge,
kp1:3.2: For a second time I go to the Dhamma for refuge,
kp1:3.3: For a second time I go to the Sangha for refuge.
kp1:4.1: For a third time I go to the Buddha for refuge,
kp1:4.2: For a third time I go to the Dhamma for refuge,
kp1:4.3: For a third time I go to the Sangha for refuge.
